```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// This file visualises approved public data. It does not calculate BNR indicators.
burden = FileAttachment("../../../../downloads/files/metrics/cvd/burden/cvd_burden_metrics_current.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

# Filters {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_indicator = Inputs.select(
  ["counts", "profile"],
  {label: "Indicator", value: "counts", format: d => ({counts: "Event count", profile: "Event distribution"}[d])}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_period_type = {
  if (selected_indicator === "profile") {
    const wrapper = html`<div style="display:none"></div>`;
    wrapper.value = "annual";
    return wrapper;
  }
  return Inputs.select(
    ["monthly", "quarterly", "annual"],
    {label: "Time period", value: "quarterly", format: d => d[0].toUpperCase() + d.slice(1)}
  );
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
event_options = selected_period_type === "monthly"
  ? ["all_cvd"]
  : ["all_cvd", "ami", "stroke"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_event_type = Inputs.select(event_options, {label: "Event type", value: "all_cvd", format: d => ({all_cvd: "All CVD", ami: "Heart attack", stroke: "Stroke"}[d])})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Complete and incomplete periods are both available. Incomplete periods are
// explicitly distinguished in the charts and table; suppressed values are not plotted.
effective_period_type = selected_indicator === "profile" ? "annual" : selected_period_type
period_control_rows = burden.filter(d =>
  d.metric_id === (selected_indicator === "counts" ? "CVD-BURDEN-001" : "CVD-BURDEN-002") &&
  d.period_type === effective_period_type
)
period_control_label = d => {
  if (effective_period_type === "monthly") {
    return new Date(d.period_year, d.period_month - 1, 1).toLocaleString(
      "en-GB",
      {month: "short", year: "numeric"}
    )
  }
  if (effective_period_type === "quarterly") {
    return `Q${d.period_quarter} ${d.period_year}`
  }
  return String(d.period_year)
}
available_periods = Array.from(
  new Map(
    period_control_rows.map(d => [
      d.period,
      {
        key: d.period,
        label: period_control_label(d),
        sort_value: new Date(d.period_start).getTime()
      }
    ])
  ).values()
).sort((a, b) => a.sort_value - b.sort_value)
max_period_index = Math.max(0, available_periods.length - 1)
start_period_label =
  effective_period_type === "monthly" ? "Start month" :
  effective_period_type === "quarterly" ? "Start quarter" :
  "Start year"
end_period_label =
  effective_period_type === "monthly" ? "End month" :
  effective_period_type === "quarterly" ? "End quarter" :
  "End year"

periodSlider = (extent, options) => {
  const control = Inputs.range(extent, {
    label: options.label,
    step: 1,
    value: options.value
  });

  const numberInput = control.querySelector('input[type="number"]');
  if (numberInput) numberInput.style.display = "none";

  const displayValue = html`<div class="bnr-period-slider-value"></div>`;
  const updateDisplay = () => {
    displayValue.textContent = options.format(Math.round(control.value));
  };

  control.append(displayValue);
  control.addEventListener("input", updateDisplay);
  updateDisplay();

  return control;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_start_period_index = periodSlider(
  [0, max_period_index],
  {
    label: start_period_label,
    value: 0,
    format: i => available_periods[i]?.label || ""
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_end_period_index = periodSlider(
  [Math.round(selected_start_period_index), max_period_index],
  {
    label: end_period_label,
    value: max_period_index,
    format: i => available_periods[i]?.label || ""
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_age_group = {
  const ageBreakdownAvailable =
    selected_indicator === "counts" &&
    selected_period_type === "annual" &&
    selected_event_type === "all_cvd";

  if (ageBreakdownAvailable) {
    return Inputs.select(
      ["all", "under_70", "age_70_plus"],
      {
        label: "Age group",
        value: "all",
        format: d => ({
          all: "All ages",
          under_70: "Under 70",
          age_70_plus: "70 and older"
        }[d])
      }
    );
  }

  const wrapper = selected_indicator === "profile"
    ? html`<div>
        <div>
          <label>Time period</label>
          <div class="bnr-period-fixed">Annual</div>
          <div class="bnr-period-note">Event distributions are published annually.</div>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:.75rem">
          <label>Age group</label>
          <div class="bnr-period-fixed">All ages</div>
          <div class="bnr-period-note">Age-specific distributions are shown only where approved public rows are available.</div>
        </div>
      </div>`
    : html`<div>
        <label>Age group</label>
        <div class="bnr-period-fixed">All ages</div>
        <div class="bnr-period-note">Age breakdown is available only for annual all-CVD counts.</div>
      </div>`;
  wrapper.value = "all";
  return wrapper;
}
```

# Indicator

## Dashboard

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| fill: false
{
  const rangeStartIndex = Math.min(
    Math.round(selected_start_period_index),
    Math.round(selected_end_period_index)
  );
  const rangeEndIndex = Math.max(
    Math.round(selected_start_period_index),
    Math.round(selected_end_period_index)
  );
  const selectedPeriodKeys = new Set(
    available_periods
      .slice(rangeStartIndex, rangeEndIndex + 1)
      .map(d => d.key)
  );
  const inSelectedPeriodRange = d => selectedPeriodKeys.has(d.period);
  const eventLabel = {all_cvd: "all CVD", ami: "heart attack", stroke: "stroke"};
  const sexLabel = {all: "All", female: "Women", male: "Men"};
  const ageLabel = {all: "All ages", under_70: "Under 70", age_70_plus: "70 and older"};
  const hasValue = d => Number.isFinite(d.value);
  const isComplete = d => d.period_complete === 1 || d.period_complete === "1" || d.period_complete === true;
  const formatValue = d => !hasValue(d) ? (d.display_value || "—") : d.unit === "percent" ? `${d.value.toFixed(1)}%` : Math.round(d.value).toLocaleString();
  const periodLabel = d => {
    if (d.period_type === "monthly") return new Date(d.period_year, d.period_month - 1, 1).toLocaleString("en-GB", {month: "short", year: "numeric"});
    if (d.period_type === "quarterly") return `Q${d.period_quarter} ${d.period_year}`;
    return String(d.period_year);
  };
  const dateValue = d => d.period_type === "annual" ? d.period_year : new Date(d.period_start);
  const sorted = rows => [...rows].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.period_start) - new Date(b.period_start));
  const latest = rows => sorted(rows)[rows.length - 1] || null;
  const headline = (label, row, note = null) => html`<div class="bnr-headline-card"><div class="bnr-headline-label">${label}</div><div class="bnr-headline-value">${row ? formatValue(row) : "—"}</div><div class="bnr-headline-note">${note || (row ? `${periodLabel(row)}${isComplete(row) ? "" : " · incomplete"}` : "No value available")}</div></div>`;
  const interpretation = (title, what, use) => html`<div class="bnr-interpretation"><div class="bnr-interpretation-title">${title}</div><div class="bnr-interpretation-grid"><div class="bnr-interpretation-label">What this shows</div><div>${what}</div><div class="bnr-interpretation-label">Interpretation</div><div>${use}</div></div></div>`;

  if (selected_indicator === "counts") {
    const statistic = `${selected_period_type}_count`;
    const comparatorStatistic = selected_period_type === "monthly" ? "monthly_same_month_previous_5yr_mean" : selected_period_type === "quarterly" ? "quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean" : "annual_previous_5yr_mean";
    const observed = sorted(burden.filter(d => d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === selected_period_type && d.statistic === statistic && d.event_type === selected_event_type && d.age_group === selected_age_group && inSelectedPeriodRange(d) && ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex)));
    const comparator = sorted(burden.filter(d => d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === selected_period_type && d.statistic === comparatorStatistic && d.event_type === selected_event_type && d.age_group === selected_age_group && inSelectedPeriodRange(d) && ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex) && hasValue(d) && d.comparison_n >= 5));
    const allObserved = observed.filter(d => d.sex === "all" && hasValue(d)).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: dateValue(d)}));
    const complete = allObserved.filter(isComplete);
    const incomplete = allObserved.filter(d => !isComplete(d));
    // Create only adjacent pairs. This prevents the solid line from bridging
    // across an incomplete observation, which is instead connected dotted.
    const pairSegments = (rows, include) => rows.slice(1).flatMap((d, i) => include(rows[i], d) ? [{...rows[i], segment: i}, {...d, segment: i}] : []);
    const completeSegments = pairSegments(allObserved, (a, b) => isComplete(a) && isComplete(b));
    const incompleteSegments = pairSegments(allObserved, (a, b) => !isComplete(a) || !isComplete(b));
    const latestAll = latest(observed.filter(d => d.sex === "all"));
    const latestFemale = latest(observed.filter(d => d.sex === "female"));
    const latestMale = latest(observed.filter(d => d.sex === "male"));
    const latestComparator = sex => {
      const observedLatest = latest(observed.filter(d => d.sex === sex));
      return latest(comparator.filter(d => d.sex === sex && observedLatest && d.period === observedLatest.period));
    };
    const ageSpecific = selected_age_group !== "all";
    const latestCards = ageSpecific
      ? html`<div class="bnr-card-grid">${headline(`Latest: ${ageLabel[selected_age_group]}`, latestAll)}</div>`
      : html`<div class="bnr-card-grid">${headline("Latest: all", latestAll)}${headline("Latest: women", latestFemale)}${headline("Latest: men", latestMale)}</div>`;
    const comparatorCards = ageSpecific
      ? html`<div class="bnr-card-grid">${headline(`Previous 5-year average: ${ageLabel[selected_age_group]}`, latestComparator("all"), latestComparator("all") ? periodLabel(latestComparator("all")) : null)}</div>`
      : html`<div class="bnr-card-grid">${headline("Previous 5-year average: all", latestComparator("all"), latestComparator("all") ? periodLabel(latestComparator("all")) : null)}${headline("Previous 5-year average: women", latestComparator("female"), latestComparator("female") ? periodLabel(latestComparator("female")) : null)}${headline("Previous 5-year average: men", latestComparator("male"), latestComparator("male") ? periodLabel(latestComparator("male")) : null)}</div>`;
    return html`<div>
      ${interpretation("Hospital-registered CVD event counts", `The number of hospital-registered ${eventLabel[selected_event_type]} events, shown by ${selected_period_type}${selected_age_group === "all" ? "" : ` for ${ageLabel[selected_age_group].toLowerCase()}`}.`, "The orange line is the same-period average over the preceding five years. Incomplete periods are lighter and use a dotted connector. Asterisks are protected values and are not plotted.")}
      <hr>
      ${latestCards}
      ${comparatorCards}
      <div class="bnr-chart-title">Trend for ${eventLabel[selected_event_type]}${selected_age_group === "all" ? ", both sexes" : `, ${ageLabel[selected_age_group].toLowerCase()}`}</div>
      <p class="bnr-trend-note">Showing ${
        available_periods[rangeStartIndex]?.label || "—"
      } to ${
        available_periods[rangeEndIndex]?.label || "—"
      }.</p>
      <div class="bnr-chart-legend"><span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style="border-color:#045174"></span>Complete period</span><span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line bnr-legend-dotted" style="border-color:#045174"></span>Incomplete period</span><span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style="border-color:rgba(232,122,0,.55);border-top-width:4px"></span>Previous 5-year average</span></div>
      ${Plot.plot({height: 470, marginLeft: 80, marginBottom: 76, style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"}, x: selected_period_type === "annual" ? {label: "Year"} : {label: selected_period_type === "monthly" ? "Month" : "Quarter", type: "time"}, y: {label: "Count", grid: true}, marks: [Plot.lineY(completeSegments, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", z: "segment", stroke: "#045174", strokeWidth: 2}), Plot.lineY(incompleteSegments, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", z: "segment", stroke: "#045174", strokeOpacity: .45, strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "5,4"}), Plot.dot(complete, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", fill: "#045174", stroke: "#045174", r: 3.5, title: d => `${periodLabel(d)}\n${formatValue(d)}\nComplete period`}), Plot.dot(incomplete, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", fill: "#045174", fillOpacity: .4, stroke: "#045174", strokeOpacity: .5, r: 3.5, title: d => `${periodLabel(d)}\n${formatValue(d)}\nIncomplete period`}), Plot.lineY(comparator.filter(d => d.sex === "all").map(d => ({...d, chart_x: dateValue(d)})), {x: "chart_x", y: "value", stroke: "rgba(232,122,0,.55)", strokeWidth: 4}), Plot.ruleY([0])]})}
    </div>`;
  }

  const profileRows = burden.filter(d =>
    d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-002" &&
    d.period_type === "annual" &&
    inSelectedPeriodRange(d) &&
    hasValue(d)
  );

  const allCvdSelected = selected_event_type === "all_cvd";

  const eventRows = sorted(profileRows.filter(d =>
    d.statistic === "event_type_distribution" &&
    d.sex === "all" &&
    ["ami", "stroke"].includes(d.event_type) &&
    isComplete(d)
  ));

  const ageRows = allCvdSelected
    ? sorted(profileRows.filter(d =>
        d.statistic === "age_distribution" &&
        d.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
        d.sex === "all" &&
        ["under_70", "age_70_plus"].includes(d.age_group) &&
        isComplete(d)
      ))
    : [];

  const sexRows = sorted(profileRows.filter(d =>
    d.statistic === "sex_distribution" &&
    d.event_type === selected_event_type &&
    ["female", "male"].includes(d.sex) &&
    isComplete(d)
  ));

  const latestRows = rows => {
    const latestYear = rows.length
      ? Math.max(...rows.map(d => d.period_year))
      : null;
    return rows.filter(d => d.period_year === latestYear);
  };

  const latestEvent = latestRows(eventRows);
  const latestAge = latestRows(ageRows);
  const latestSex = latestRows(sexRows);

  const stack = (rows, key, order) =>
    Array.from(new Set(rows.map(d => d.period_year))).flatMap(year => {
      let total = 0;
      return rows
        .filter(d => d.period_year === year)
        .sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a[key]) - order.indexOf(b[key]))
        .map(d => {
          const x1 = total;
          total += d.value;
          return {...d, x1, x2: total, year_label: String(year)};
        });
    });

  const eventStack = stack(eventRows, "event_type", ["ami", "stroke"]);
  const ageStack = stack(ageRows, "age_group", ["under_70", "age_70_plus"]);
  const sexStack = stack(sexRows, "sex", ["female", "male"]);

  const eventSection = eventRows.length
    ? html`<div>
        <div class="bnr-chart-title">Event type distribution: all CVD</div>
        <div class="bnr-card-grid">
          ${headline("Latest: heart attack", latestEvent.find(d => d.event_type === "ami"))}

        </div>
        <div class="bnr-chart-legend">
          <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style="background:#D89C60"></span>Heart attack</span>

        </div>
        ${Plot.plot({

          marginLeft: 80,
          marginBottom: 55,
          style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"},
          x: {label: "Percent of events", domain: [0, 100], grid: true},
          y: {label: "Year", domain: Array.from(new Set(eventStack.map(d => d.year_label)))},
          color: {domain: ["ami", "stroke"], range: ["#D89C60", "#045174"], legend: false},
          marks: [
            Plot.barX(eventStack, {
              y: "year_label",
              x1: "x1",
              x2: "x2",
              fill: "event_type",
              title: d => `${d.period_year}\n${eventLabel[d.event_type]}\n${formatValue(d)}`
            }),
            Plot.ruleX([0])
          ]
        })}
      </div>`
    : "";

  const ageSection = ageRows.length
    ? html`<div>
        <div class="bnr-chart-title">Age distribution: all CVD</div>
        <div class="bnr-card-grid">
          ${headline("Latest: under 70", latestAge.find(d => d.age_group === "under_70"))}
          ${headline("Latest: 70 and older", latestAge.find(d => d.age_group === "age_70_plus"))}
        </div>
        <div class="bnr-chart-legend">
          <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style="background:#D89C60"></span>Under 70</span>
          <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style="background:#045174"></span>70 and older</span>
        </div>
        ${Plot.plot({
          height: 330,
          marginLeft: 80,
          marginBottom: 55,
          style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"},
          x: {label: "Percent of events", domain: [0, 100], grid: true},
          y: {label: "Year", domain: Array.from(new Set(ageStack.map(d => d.year_label)))},
          color: {domain: ["under_70", "age_70_plus"], range: ["#D89C60", "#045174"], legend: false},
          marks: [
            Plot.barX(ageStack, {
              y: "year_label",
              x1: "x1",
              x2: "x2",
              fill: "age_group",
              title: d => `${d.period_year}\n${ageLabel[d.age_group]}\n${formatValue(d)}`
            }),
            Plot.ruleX([0])
          ]
        })}
      </div>`
    : "";

  const sexSection = sexRows.length
    ? html`<div>
        <div class="bnr-chart-title">Sex distribution: ${eventLabel[selected_event_type]}</div>
        <div class="bnr-card-grid">
          ${headline("Latest: women", latestSex.find(d => d.sex === "female"))}
          ${headline("Latest: men", latestSex.find(d => d.sex === "male"))}
        </div>
        <div class="bnr-chart-legend">
          <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style="background:#D89C60"></span>Women</span>
          <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style="background:#045174"></span>Men</span>
        </div>
        ${Plot.plot({
          height: 330,
          marginLeft: 80,
          marginBottom: 55,
          style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"},
          x: {label: "Percent of events", domain: [0, 100], grid: true},
          y: {label: "Year", domain: Array.from(new Set(sexStack.map(d => d.year_label)))},
          color: {domain: ["female", "male"], range: ["#D89C60", "#045174"], legend: false},
          marks: [
            Plot.barX(sexStack, {
              y: "year_label",
              x1: "x1",
              x2: "x2",
              fill: "sex",
              title: d => `${d.period_year}\n${sexLabel[d.sex]}\n${formatValue(d)}`
            }),
            Plot.ruleX([0])
          ]
        })}
      </div>`
    : "";

  return html`<div>
    ${interpretation(
      "Distribution of hospital-registered CVD events",
      allCvdSelected
        ? "The annual distribution of published hospital-registered CVD events by event type, broad age group and sex."
        : `The annual distribution of published hospital-registered CVD events by event type, with the sex distribution for ${eventLabel[selected_event_type]}.`,
      "These percentages describe the mix of registered events. They are not population risks, incidence rates or measures of disease probability. Incomplete and suppressed annual distributions are shown in the data table only."
    )}
    <hr>
    ${eventSection}
    ${ageSection}
    ${sexSection}
  </div>`;
}
```
